lexicon.title: Translations
lexicon.description: Labels written in double braces in blueprints, such as the blueprint name or a tab label, are looked up here for each user's language. Untranslated labels fall back to English.
lexicon.readOnly: You can view translations. Changing them requires permission to edit blueprints.
lexicon.noTranslations: No translations in {{language}} yet. Labels in this language show their English text until you add some.
lexicon.needsTranslationDescription: These labels are used by blueprints or reusable attributes but show English text in {{language}}.
lexicon.fullyTranslated: Every translatable label has a translation in {{language}}.
lexicon.missingPluralCategories: Missing plural forms: {{categories}}. Shown with entity counts, such as Explorer result totals.
lexicon.keyHelp: The English text inside the braces, matched exactly.
lexicon.contextHelp: Optional. The part after | that tells homonyms apart; it is never shown.
lexicon.pluralCategoryHelp: Use other for labels shown without a number.
lexicon.unusedDescription: No blueprint revision or reusable attribute references this key.
lexicon.deleteTranslationDescription: Delete the {{category}} translation of “{{key}}”? Labels using it will show the English text.
lexicon.importDescription: Choose a JSON or TOML file in the format that Export and acli lexicon export produce. Its language comes from the file.
lexicon.invalidFile: This file is not a valid lexicon file.
lexicon.invalidLanguage: The file's language is not a valid language tag.

importModes.merge: Add and update entries; keep the others
importModes.replace: Replace the language: also delete entries missing from the file
